scene: The claw drops a glowing token that unlocks three transit gates outside.
picture: Along a single bottom ground line, a sleek magenta light-rail pod waits with open doors on the far left. The Korean teenage boy in a mint-green hoodie stands on the left holding a glowing token. A turquoise river hover ferry idles at a centre dock, beside an open glass karaoke lift on the far right.
